Values centred on the importance of work: diligence, reliability, punctuality and pride in a job well done.

front: Name five threats to workplace norms and values.
back: Corruption, absenteeism, theft, harassment, poor work ethic (also nepotism, substance abuse).
Favouring relatives when giving jobs or promotions.

front: Why is confidentiality important in a clinic?
back: Patients trust the clinic with private information; if it were shared, some would stay away and their health would suffer.

back: Codes of conduct and induction; leadership by example; accountability systems such as audits (also fair rewards, training, fair discipline).
